## User-reported core issue —3November2026
Jason: the same sort of playback in Open Play is much quieter than Serato/other apps. Exact compared track/settings/device/OS volume were not captured. Treat as a core gain-staging/calibration issue, not proven proprietary-DSP mismatch.

Native138 current session: Master Output−10dB, trackgainA−7/B−3.2dB, channel faders80%, trim0, AutoGainON/reference92, hiddenMixerMasterVolume100%, Linearcrosscentre/amount50/upfader50, filtersOff. Source output stage reserves3dB. Derived from rounded controls: roughly−21.94dBA/−18.14dBB vs original file below limiting; this is NOT measured Serato difference. Fresh app master defaults0dB;−10 is restored session state. Source tracing shows the separate gains; no demonstrated double application. Current-engine raw-forward PCM is now captured: with controlled track gain−7dB, fader80%, neutral EQ/trim, linear centre crossfader and Master Volume100%, measured source-to-output loss is−21.9382dB at master−10 and−11.9382dB at master0. The10dB difference is exact within Float32 precision. Independent decoding/hash/RMS checks cover all8complete stereo witness buffers,44100alignedframes/channel/case. No extra attenuation or limiter reduction in this measured path; this is not a Serato comparison.

## Acceptance
- [x] Record current gain chain/settings and preserve stopped session; no loudness change while owner is away.
- [x] Focused physically-muted current-engine PCM capture with the observed A gain staging versus neutral master; expected ratios, finite output, limiter inactive.117controls/6previews retained; cleanup stopped/muted. No broad matrix.
- [ ] Same local track/section, same output device and OS volume, equivalent Serato mode/master/AutoGain/channel/crossfader settings. Serato performance0dB and offline100% are different controls.
- [ ] If measured unintended attenuation exists, fix its shared owner once; preserve headroom, limiter and gain persistence. Do not blindly boost all songs or change manual saved levels.
- [ ] Owner safe-level listening comparison when available; retain any clipping/headroom/perceived-loudness limitations. Reported issue stays OPEN until supported.
